feature: Use the actual workbook read fingerprint for candidate selection

backend_full.environment: new Worker image; network disabled; isolated SQLite and files; real LibreOffice; simulated inspection receipts

deployment.strategy: Back up and update the existing backend and Worker containers in place. Build images separately; retain all containers, volumes, files and historical Runs.

boundaries: No production Run or inspection write is created for verification.
Historical failed Run retains its original snapshot and status.
Discovery of entirely new paths still requires the file index scan.
